name: Respiratory variants & flu
summary: Early flu season in the US and UK; CDC expects admissions to rise through mid-November
state: The CDC forecasts US flu hospital admissions will keep climbing through mid-November after the season's first child death, in an early season (CDC FluView; Nature World News, 4 Nov). UKHSA reports flu rising unusually early in England (EMJ). Health systems are not reported as strained, and no WHO variant of concern had been designated as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Eligible people can get flu and COVID-19 vaccines; follow NHS and UKHSA advice.
rubric_hit: Unusually early flu season in a hemisphere = Watch

sources.title: CDC — Weekly US influenza surveillance report, week 42
EMJ — Flu rising unusually early this season, reports UKHSA

why: Known viruses change; a new COVID-19 variant or a severe flu strain can strain health systems without being 'novel'.
drivers: Viral evolution, waning immunity, seasonal patterns, vaccine match.

rubric.alert: WHO designates a variant of concern, or flu or COVID-19 hospitalisations strain several countries' health systems.
rubric.watch: WHO designates a new variant of interest, or a hemisphere's flu season is unusually early or severe.
rubric.normal: No WHO variant of interest rising fast; flu seasons of normal severity.
